exposure: preventive or curative low molecular-weight heparin
cohort: 127 pregnant patients on low molecular-weight heparin at the time of delivery
finding: Planned induction tended to increase the rate of neuraxial analgesia, but the difference was not statistically significant.
mod_finding: Planned induction of labor tended to increase the rate of neuraxial analgesia, without reaching significance, and most women in spontaneous labor accessed analgesia.
